card.lookAround: I just want to look around

beats.1: World Zero is a game you play in real life.
beats.2: Like many games, you will start by creating a character. This character doesn’t need to be you.
beats.3: Like in many games, you will have a variety of tasks you can complete (such as “slay a dragon” or “find a cool stick”).
beats.4: Complete them and post proof (in the form of photos, videos or audio) in order to get points.
beats.5: Other players vote on the proof you post. The more they like it, the more points you get.
beats.6: When you get enough points, you can level up and have access to more interesting, more difficult tasks, and vote to give points to tasks others have completed well.

b2.sub: Not you. Unless you want it to be.

beats.7: Along the way there will be warring organizations, mysteries and most likely character development. World Zero will always be free and have no ads.

beat5.hint: Your turn: vote on the card

auth.title: Login Logistics
auth.body: World Zero keeps only your email, an ID from the service you sign in with, and whatever you post yourself. This means we ask someone else to confirm that your email belongs to you. Choose your way in.
